purpose: Research registry of external IPA/G2P candidates. Entries are not active runtime dependencies and are not accepted pronunciation gold data.

integration_contract.pipeline: source orthography -> language-specific structural/phonological analysis -> typed IPA result -> ClippyFirst IPA-to-Ukrainian adapter -> practical Ukrainian orthography
prohibited: silently rewriting external output into IPA without a documented conversion
using unverified output as gold data

candidates.name: mya2rom
candidates.output: Early-stage; Wikipedia-flavor IPA with known convention differences (including nasalization notation); compare before acceptance
candidates.license: Verify repository license and attribution of imported sources

candidates.name: myG2P
candidates.output: Inspect structured pronunciation/IPA fields, lexicon version, coverage and provenance
candidates.license: Verify exact version and dictionary license

candidates.name: burmese-G2P
candidates.output: Versioned output conventions differ; validate IPA and service-particle errors
candidates.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 reported upstream; non-commercial restriction blocks commercial reuse unless separately resolved

candidates.name: Goruut
candidates.output: Burmese support is claimed; verify standard/dialect, tones, register/phonation and IPA convention
candidates.license: Verify current upstream license and model/data terms

candidates.name: eSpeak NG
candidates.output: Check Burmese voice, phoneme inventory and explicit IPA output; don't treat engine codes as IPA without conversion

candidates.name: Epitran
candidates.output: An optional raw-output baseline is already implemented in scripts/benchmark_g2p.py using the mya-Mymr mapping; verify Burmese coverage, dialect, tone/phonation, IPA convention, and mapping provenance before interpreting outputs.
candidates.license: Upstream project reports an open-source license; verify the exact pinned release, bundled mapping/data licenses, and notices before reuse or redistribution.

candidates.name: Charis SIL
candidates.output: Recommended font candidate for readable IPA and combining diacritics
candidates.license: SIL Open Font License; verify current release metadata

candidates.name: Doulos SIL
candidates.output: IPA-focused font candidate; verify combining-diacritic rendering in target browsers
candidates.license: SIL Open Font License; verify current release metadata

candidates.name: DejaVu Sans
candidates.output: Broad Unicode/IPA fallback candidate; test exact glyph coverage on target devices

candidates.name: Inter Font Extensions
candidates.kind: script-font extensions (Thai/Khmer/Myanmar; not an IPA font)
candidates.output: May improve display of the source scripts in interfaces; does not generate IPA and is not a replacement for an IPA-capable Latin font
candidates.license: Verify current upstream font and repository license

candidates.name: Padauk
candidates.output: Useful for Myanmar-script text shaping and coverage; not an IPA transcription engine
candidates.license: SIL Open Font License; verify current release metadata

candidates.name: Busra
candidates.output: Khmer-script display font only; not an IPA transcription engine
candidates.license: SIL Open Font License; verify current release metadata

candidates.name: Mondulkiri
candidates.output: Khmer-script display font only; not an IPA transcription engine
candidates.license: SIL Open Font License; verify current release metadata

benchmark_protocol.scoring_gate: Only independently adjudicated, non-empty gold_ipa rows are scored.
benchmark_protocol.notes: Registry membership does not establish language support, IPA output semantics, reproducibility, accuracy, or license compatibility. Preserve raw output and record exact versions and model/data licenses.
